description: When traffic or an integration seems to have disappeared, list recent OBSERVED → STALE edge transitions. Returns the edges that went quiet and when; quiet is a signal to investigate, not proof the dependency is healthy or removed.

edgeType.description: Filter by edge type — e.g. "CALLS" or "CONNECTS_TO"

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_recent_stale_edges
